datasource.name: Finished Merged
datasource.description: Union of 6 yearly Hyper extracts (2020-2025) that were split out of Start.hyper by split_by_year.py and rejoined by union_hyper_files.py using Hyper's native attach_database + CREATE TABLE ... AS SELECT ... UNION ALL (no row ever passed through Python). Contains 6092 rows spanning 2020-07-09 to 2025-09-23.

columns.name: Chain Id
columns.description: Unique identifier for a possession chain -- a continuous sequence of play by one team from gaining possession until it changes hands or the ball becomes dead.

columns.name: Match Id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the match this chain occurred in.

columns.name: Season
columns.description: The season (year) the match belongs to, as recorded in the source system.

columns.name: Competition
columns.description: Name of the competition or league the match was part of.

columns.name: Match Date
columns.description: Calendar date the match was played. This is the column split_by_year.py partitions on to produce one file per year.

columns.name: Venue
columns.description: Name of the stadium or ground where the match was played.

columns.name: Home Or Away
columns.description: Whether the team recorded on this row was playing at home or away.

columns.name: Team
columns.description: The team in possession during this chain.

columns.name: Opposition
columns.description: The opposing team.

columns.name: Period
columns.description: The period of the match the chain occurred in (e.g. first half, second half).

columns.name: Period Seconds
columns.description: Elapsed time, in seconds, into the period when the chain started.

columns.name: Chain Start State
columns.description: How the chain began, e.g. from a set piece, turnover, or restart.

columns.name: Chain Start Zone
columns.description: The area of the field where the chain started.

columns.name: Chain Duration Seconds
columns.description: Total duration of the chain, in seconds.

columns.name: Chain Phases
columns.description: Number of phases (individual plays/tackles) within the chain.

columns.name: Chain End State
columns.description: How the chain ended, e.g. try scored, turnover, kick.

columns.name: Ruck Speed Seconds
columns.description: Average time, in seconds, taken to recycle the ball at the ruck during the chain.

columns.name: Metres Gained
columns.description: Net metres gained by the team in possession during the chain.

columns.name: Set Piece Result
columns.description: Outcome of the set piece (e.g. scrum, lineout) that started or ended the chain, where applicable.

columns.name: Kick Territory Metres
columns.description: Net territory gained from kicks during the chain, in metres.

columns.name: Turnover Origin
columns.description: How possession was lost, when the chain ended in a turnover.

column_description_disclaimer: Column descriptions were inferred from column names and general rugby possession-chain analytics conventions by whoever wrote generate_metadata.py -- they are not sourced from authoritative documentation for this dataset. Review and correct COLUMN_DESCRIPTIONS in generate_metadata.py before relying on them.
